原著 吴承恩

内容提要
孙悟空从东海得了金箍棒回来，十分喜悦，连日在水帘洞内欢宴庆贺。一天，他酒后入梦，蒙眬中被带入森罗殿，一时性起，大闹地府。事后被天上的玉皇大帝知道了，降旨招安，将悟空召上天去，给他做了个专饲养马的弼马温。悟空初时不知，后从同僚中得知自己原来是个管马的末等官职，心中不悦，便反下天来。玉帝闻知此事，觉得有失自己威严，当即派天兵天将下界擒拿，哪知均遭惨败，无奈何，只得替他在天上建造了一所“齐天大圣”府，封他做了“齐天大圣”。
page_text_en:
Monkey King
Part Three of "Journey to the West"
Original Work: Wu Cheng'en
Adapted by: Lai Yongfen
Illustrated by: Liu Hanzhong

Hebei Fine Arts Publishing House

Synopsis
Sun Wukong returned from the Eastern Sea with the Golden Cudgel, overjoyed, and celebrated for days in the Water Curtain Cave. One day, after drinking, he fell asleep and, in a daze, was taken to the Hall of Yama, where he lost his temper and caused chaos in the Underworld. When the Jade Emperor learned of this, he issued an edict to pacify him, summoning Wukong to Heaven and appointing him as the弼马温 (Bì Mǎ Wēn), a minor official in charge of tending horses. Initially unaware of his lowly position, Wukong later learned from his colleagues that he was merely a low-ranking horse keeper, which angered him, and he rebelled and returned to Earth. Upon hearing this, the Jade Emperor felt his authority was undermined and immediately sent heavenly soldiers and generals to capture him, but they were all defeated. With no other choice, he had a palace built for him in Heaven called the "Monkey King's Palace" and bestowed upon him the title of "Monkey King".
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《齐天大圣》的版权页和内容提要，介绍了孙悟空因大闹地府被招安为弼马温，后因不满官职反下天庭，最终被封为“齐天大圣”的故事梗概。

2 酒后，六洞王起身告辞。悟空亲自送他们走出洞口，六王各驾云头，分别返回自己洞府去了。

1 The Monkey King Sun Wukong, after obtaining the Golden Cudgel from the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea, held feasts for several days in a row. On this day, he invited six cave kings, hosted a grand banquet, drank heartily, and everyone got thoroughly drunk.
2 After the feast, the six cave kings rose to take their leave. Wukong personally saw them out of the cave entrance, and the six kings each mounted their clouds, returning to their own cave palaces.

4 In a daze, he saw two people coming with a document. The document bore the name "Sun Wukong." Just as Wukong was about to ask, the two suddenly used a rope to cover his head and dragged him away without hesitation.

5 Wukong, tired from drinking, was led unsteadily to the edge of a city. Looking up, he saw an iron plaque on the city wall with the three large characters: 'Youning Jie' (Underworld).
6 At this moment, Wukong suddenly sobered and asked, 'The Underworld is where the King of Hell resides. Why have you brought me here?' The two replied, 'You don't know yet. Your life span has ended. We are here on orders to arrest you!' Upon hearing this, Wukong became furious.

10 Wukong angrily said: "Who doesn't know I am Sun Wukong, the naturally born sage of the Water Curtain Cave in Flower-Fruit Mountain! What are your positions? 11 The Ten Kings said, 'Immortal, please calm down. There are many people with the same name and surname in the world. Perhaps the officers have made a mistake and arrested the wrong person.' 12 At once, Wukong, holding his golden cudgel, raised his head and stepped forward, ascending directly to the Hall of Yama, sitting in the center. The Ten Kings ordered the judge to bring out the records for inspection. How could the judge dare to be negligent? 14 Wukong took the pen and crossed out all entries for monkeys. He then threw the pen down, saying, 'Settled, settled! From now on, you won't be in charge of me!' Saying this, he rose from his seat, swung his golden cudgel, smashed the Wheel of Rebirth, and stormed out of the Hall of Judgment.

19 King Qin Guang arrived at the Lingxiao Palace, where Emperor Yu Huang was holding court. As he was about to step forward to report, the Dragon King Ao Guang from the Eastern Sea stepped out and reported that Sun Wukong had been acting violently and demanding the Golden Cudgel, requesting that heavenly generals be sent to subdue him. King Qin Guang also stepped forward to report that Wukong had caused a great disturbance in the Hall of Ten Kings.
20 The Jade Emperor, upon hearing the report, became furious and asked the assembled civil and military immortals: 'This monkey demon is so defiant— which heavenly general shall descend to subdue him?' Before he finished speaking, the Star of Tai Bai Changgeng stepped forward to advise. The Jade Emperor agreed and ordered the Star of Tai Bai Jin Xing to descend to the mortal realm to pacify him.
What the Star of Changgeng has proposed is sound. I hereby issue an edict, sending the Star of Tai Bai Jin Xing to pacify him.
